coastal.title: Evacuation alert issued for wildfire burning near Lions Bay, B.C.
coastal.description: A wildfire has prompted an evacuation alert for about 30 properties in a community just north of Vancouver.

coastal.title: Rare thunderstorm with lightning strikes wows southern B.C., causing havoc at Vancouver airport
coastal.description: A preliminary count from Environment Canada reported more than 1,800 incidences of lightning over the Lower Mainland on Saturday night and Sunday morning, while the B.C. Wildfire Service said it recorded more than 7,000 strikes provincewide.

coastal.title: B.C. Conservative MLA for Abbotsford-Mission to step down, paving way for new leader to seek election
coastal.description: The B.C. Conservative MLA for Abbotsford-Mission has announced she will be stepping down, and Conservative Leader Kerry-Lynne Findlay plans to seek the vacant seat.

kamloops.title: Wildfires expose accessibility failures: advocates
kamloops.description: Janice Lyons was upstairs in her Summerland, B.C., home when there was a flash at her doorbell, which lights up in her Deaf household in place of a chime.

kamloops.title: Preschool fire safety lessons put to the test during Summerland evacuation
kamloops.description: As Learning Cove Preschool prepares to welcome children back, staff say fire safety lessons taught in the classroom helped prepare students

kamloops.title: Summerland residents gather for first Sunday market since wildfire evacuation
kamloops.description: For the first time since the Bald Range wildfire forced the evacuation of around 20,000 Summerland, B.C., properties earlier this month, residents gathered for the weekly community market.

kamloops.title: Summerland family feels 'violated' after burglary during wildfire evacuation
kamloops.description: Mira Boucher says her home was ransacked by looters while her community of Summerland was empty and vulnerable — with every single house vacant under an evacuation order.

kamloops.title: Summerland wildfire evacuee says overhaul of emergency support services needed
kamloops.description: Dawne Young, a retired 911 dispatcher, said her evacuation experience was unsettling. Her neighbour's home was lost in the Bald Range wildfire. She said her family did not all receive the emergency alert, and she was met with lengthy delays trying to register as an evacuee.

prince-george.title: Food-conditioned bear killed in Fort Nelson, as resident launches community safety petition
prince-george.description: The B.C. Conservation Officer Service says a black bear in Fort Nelson, B.C., was killed on Aug. 19 after several reports of the bear going door-to-door knocking over garbage bins.

all.title: Studying combined fuel treatments gives us a better picture of effectiveness
all.description: While many studies have established that fuel treatments are an effective wildfire mitigation tool, the gap in our understanding has been how a range of different treatments work together over many years across large areas to produce a desired outcome. Research led by Boise State University PhD student Kendra Fallon, now a National Fire Ecologist […]

all.title: Global wildland fire conference announced for Melbourne 2028
all.description: The largest international wildland fire conference is heading back to Australia in 2028. The 9th International Wildland Fire Conference will be held in Melbourne, Australia, from 4-7 April 2028 under the theme of “Fire Knowledge, shared across the world”. The once in every four years event was announced this week at the opening of the […]

all.title: B.C. storm causes new wildfires, airport delays after more than 7K lightning strikes
all.description: After a fierce storm caused havoc in B.C. overnight Saturday, officials warn the hot, dry and windy conditions in the forecast could increase the potential for wildfire activity.

all.title: 'Super' El Niño didn't cause this year's fires and heat waves, but it's about to take us on a 'wild ride'
all.description: Whether you call it a "super" El Niño or a "Godzilla" El Niño, the naturally occurring Pacific Ocean warming phenomenon that disrupts global weather patterns is back and packing a punch, at a time when many parts of the planet are already overheated.
